attributes._cssText: body { font: 14px / 1.5 -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0px; padding: 16px 20px; background: rgb(247, 247, 245); color: rgb(28, 30, 34); }h1 { font-size: 16px; margin: 0px 0px 4px; }.sub { color: rgb(91, 95, 102); font-size: 12px; margin: 0px 0px 14px; }.row { display: flex; gap: 16px; align-items: flex-start; flex-wrap: wrap; }.card { background: rgb(255, 255, 255); border: 1px solid rgb(226, 226, 221); border-radius: 10px; padding: 14px; }#target { width: 150px; height: 46px; font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; font-size: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-family: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit; font-language-override: inherit; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; background: rgb(42, 95, 216); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; border-radius: 8px; }#hoverbox { width: 150px; height: 46px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px dashed rgb(154, 160, 168); border-radius: 8px; }#hoverbox.on { background: rgb(228, 244, 238); border-color: rgb(14, 138, 95); }input, textarea { font: inherit; padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid rgb(226, 226, 221); border-radius: 7px; width: 260px; }canvas { border: 1px solid rgb(226, 226, 221); border-radius: 8px; background: rgb(255, 255, 255); display: block; }pre { background: rgb(21, 23, 27); color: rgb(232, 234, 238); padding: 10px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 11px; max-height: 230px; overflow: auto; margin: 8px 0px 0px; }.stat { font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 12px; }.scrollbox { height: 90px; width: 260px; overflow-y: scroll; border: 1px solid rgb(226, 226, 221); border-radius: 7px; background: rgb(255, 255, 255); }.scrollbox div { height: 40px; padding: 6px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(240, 240, 236); }

childNodes.textContent: Records every input event the page actually receives, so humanized and non-humanized runs can be compared on evidence rather than impression.
cursor trail — green = first sample, red = latest

Tall filler so the WINDOW itself can scroll a full viewport, which is what
     "scroll down one screen" means. Without it the page fits and a page-level
     scroll is a no-op.
